parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the outer shell and internal supports.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports other components such as the shelf, door, and drawer.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds all other parts in place.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a flat horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space and supports stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged front panel made of plywood, attached to the frame with metal hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet and protects contents from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a box-like compartment that slides in and out of the cabinet frame, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides enclosed storage for smaller items and is frequently accessed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly in and out along metal runners or slides.
